assets.title: Sit-Down Arcade Racer
assets.description: Original single static low-poly sit-down arcade racing machine on a continuous chamfered ground base. An orange deep bucket seat has a reclined back, side bolsters and enclosed lower support. An open footwell leads to two separate inclined fixed pedals on real struts. A three-spoke tilted steering ring is attached by a shaft to a separate console with two base-supported inclined legs. A broad framed blank screen pod is supported by the front cabinet. Screen_Runtime is an exclusive named mesh with its own Runtime screen exclusive solid PBR material, ready for content replacement by a consuming application. Teal shell, coral upholstery, dark rubber and pale bezel remain separately editable; all components have actual interior support witnesses leading to the shared base. Finite seat, lap and foot-approach volumes are geometrically empty; the geometry is not a human-fit guarantee. Metres, source Z up, rider facing +Y, origin at ground projection of base centre. Seven solid PBR materials, no textures or external dependencies. Static game visual only: no game content, trademarks, networking, input device, steering/pedal action, driving physics, human fit, load or amusement-equipment safety certification.
